title: Professional Reviewer Identity v1
description: The minimal identity record for a real, named professional reviewer — separate from their fit-for-review profile (see reviewer-qualification.schema.json). No placeholder, generic, or invented reviewer may ever populate this shape in the active registry. See docs/bible/15-professional-validation/413-reviewer-role-model.md and 439-reviewer-independence-and-conflicts.md.

displayName.description: The reviewer's real name, as they consent to have it recorded — never invented, never a placeholder like 'Reviewer A'.

conflicts.description: Disclosed potential conflicts (e.g. 'JewelMind contributor', 'vendor relationship') — recorded transparently, not a legal independence certification.
